## Summary
Ariyan Khan is a freelance video editor based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, helping YouTube creators,
brands, founders, coaches, educators, podcasters, healthcare professionals, and agencies grow
through high-retention video content. He specializes in four core editing styles — talking head
YouTube videos, cinematic documentaries, short-form social content (TikTok, Instagram Reels,
YouTube Shorts), and animated map/geopolitical visuals — plus audience-specific services for
founders, coaches, corporate teams, podcasters, healthcare professionals, and fitness creators.
5M+ total views generated for clients, 314+ satisfied clients, and an average 60%+ audience
retention rate on edited videos.

## Core Services

### Talking Head Video Editing
- High-retention edits for YouTube creators, coaches, educators, and founders
- Includes: smart cuts and pacing, captions, B-roll, color grading, audio cleanup, motion graphics
- Turnaround: varies by length and complexity — discussed per project
- URL: https://ariyankhan.com/talking-head-video-editing.html

### Documentary Video Editing
- Professional long-form documentary editing with cinematic quality
- Includes: narrative structure, interview assembly, cinematic color grade, sound mix
- Delivery: 4K export, 2 revision rounds included, 7-10 day delivery
- URL: https://ariyankhan.com/documentary-video-editing.html

### Short Form Video Editing
- Scroll-stopping edits for vertical platforms
- Platforms: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
- Includes: strong hooks, fast-paced cuts, animated captions, sound design, 9:16 delivery
- Turnaround: usually within 24 hours
- URL: https://ariyankhan.com/short-form-video-editing.html

### Map Animation & Geopolitical Visuals
- Cinematic animated maps for visual storytelling
- Includes: country highlights, route animations, zoom transitions, geopolitical context
- Best for: documentary makers, history & geography YouTube channels, explainer videos
- URL: https://ariyankhan.com/map-animation-video-editing.html

### Remote Video Editor
- Full-service remote video editing for clients hiring across time zones
- Includes: secure cloud-based file transfer, async communication, timestamped remote review, flexible international payment (PayPal, Wise, bank transfer)
- Best for: YouTube creators, startups, marketing teams, and businesses hiring an editor without an in-person meeting
- URL: https://ariyankhan.com/service/remote-video-editor.html

## Tools & Software
- Primary: Adobe Premiere Pro
- Color Grading: DaVinci Resolve
- Motion Graphics: Adobe After Effects
- Audio: Adobe Audition, Premiere Pro audio tools

## Editing Process
1. The Brief — Understanding your vision, audience, and goals. A clear brief is written before editing begins.
2. Rough Cut — Building the story structure, finding the strongest moments, setting pacing and narrative flow.
3. Fine Cut + Graphics — Precision editing with motion graphics, captions, B-roll, lower thirds, and transitions.
4. Color + Audio — Cinematic color grading, professional audio mix, noise reduction, and music.
5. Delivery + Revisions — Export in required format, platform-optimized. Source files available on request.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I request revisions?
Documentary projects include 2 rounds of free revisions. Other services include a first-cut
review and revision round before final delivery. Additional revision rounds are available for
a small fee.

### What is your delivery time?
Delivery time depends on the length and complexity of the footage and which service it is.
Short-form edits are usually delivered within 24 hours, documentaries take 7-10 days, and
talking-head or audience-specific edits are scoped per project.

### Can you match my existing editing style?
Yes. Send a reference video and Ariyan will match the color grade, pacing, captions, motion
graphics, and overall feel to keep it consistent with your existing channel or brand.

### Do you provide source files?
Yes, Adobe Premiere Pro project files are available upon request for an additional fee. Final
video is delivered in any required format — 4K, 1080p, vertical (9:16), square, or custom
aspect ratios.

### How do I get started?
Fill out the contact form at https://ariyankhan.com/#contact with your project details.
